verses.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ੨ : ਮਨਮੁਖ ਤੇ ਡੱਡੂ ਇਕੋ ਜਿਹੇ ਹਨ
verses.translit_en: pauRee 2 : manmukh te dda'ddoo iko jihe han

en.bdb: Manmukh, the mind oriented and frog are identical  -

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨੀਰੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਾ ਸੁਭਰ ਸਰਵਰਿ ਕਵਲ ਫੁਲੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: niramal neer suhaavanaa subhar saravar kaval fula(n)dhe|

en.bdb: It is a pond full of pure and fine water wherein the lotuses blossom.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰੂਪ ਅਨੂਪ ਸਰੂਪ ਅਤਿ ਗੰਧ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਹੋਇ ਮਹਕੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: roop anoop saroop at ga(n)dh suga(n)dh hoi mahaka(n)dhe|

en.bdb: Lotuses are of beautiful form and they make the environment fragrant.

verses.gurmukhi: ਭਵਰਾਂ ਵਾਸਾ ਵੰਝ ਵਣਿ ਖੋਜਹਿ ਏਕੋ ਖੋਜਿ ਲਹੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: bhavaraa(n) vaasaa va(n)jh van khojeh eko khoj laha(n)dhe|

en.bdb: Black bees live in bamboo forest but they somehow search and get the lotus.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲੋਭ ਲੁਭਤਿ ਮਕਰੰਦ ਰਸਿ ਦੂਰਿ ਦਿਸੰਤਰਿ ਆਇ ਮਿਲੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: lobh lubhat makara(n)dh ras dhoor dhisa(n)tar aai mila(n)dhe|

en.bdb: With the sunrise, they come attracted from far and wide and meet the lotus.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੂਰਜੁ ਗਗਨਿ ਉਦੋਤ ਹੋਇ ਸਰਵਰ ਕਵਲ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਧਰੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: sooraj gagan udhot hoi saravar kaval dhiaan dhara(n)dhe|

en.bdb: With the sunrise, the lotuses of the pond also turn their faces toward the sun.

verses.gurmukhi: ਡੱਡੂ ਚਿਕੜਿ ਵਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਕਵਲ ਸਿਞਾਣਿ ਨ ਮਾਣਿ ਸਕੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: dda'ddoo chikaR vaas hai kaval sin(j)aan na maan saka(n)dhe|

en.bdb: Frond lives in the nearby mire close to the lotus but not understanding the real delight it cannot enjoy like lotus.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸ ਨ ਰਹਤ ਰਹੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: saadhasa(n)gat gur sabadh sun gur upadhes na rahat raha(n)dhe|

en.bdb: Those unfortunate persons who listening to the teachings of the Guru in the holy congregation do not adopt them.
They are most unfortunate in life like the frogs.
